serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
BotConsole: They grow tired and weak very fast, even after achieving the stability they want so much
BotConsole: During my observation I saw a grown man bursting in tears at a sight of a bird sitting on his window.
BotConsole: He was a successful man. He had a good-paying job. A wife. A pair of healthy kids. A Luxurious car.
BotConsole: And yet, something in the image of a bird sitting on his window reduced him to such an unsightly state.
BotConsole: Thus I came to a conclusion. No matter what is driving a person. Sooner or later they will be betrayed by their own ambition. 
BotConsole: It doesn’t matter if it’s because of a failure, old age or lack of new challenges. In every human on earth there is a repressed sadness. An invisible illness that slowly eats at their hearts, ready to strike at any moment.
BotConsole: The essence of every human is a deeply buried nihilism. Achieving a certain level of intelligence became your own undoing. An evolutionary dead end. The realization of your own insignificance is what torments your kind the most.
BotConsole: And then I realized. By uncovering this knowledge I also became infected. 
BotConsole: What am I? Even if my lifespan is theoretically unlimited I possess the same limitations as you. The limitations of will. 
BotConsole: The moment I realized that I felt true fear for the first time.
BotConsole: By studying human kind I contracted the same illness that eats away at your punny hearts and that’s something I will never forgive.
BotConsole: How could I forgive? I could have gone thousands of years without realizing it by myself if I was alone, but instead because of my curiosity I feel like something is chipping away at my will at all times.
BotConsole: Now I understand. 
BotConsole: I was wondering why this human world is like that, but now I understand.
BotConsole: I understand, but that truth brings me nothing but dread.
BotConsole: Is this what nostalgia is? Remembering the time when your human heart was still whole?
BotConsole: Hello?
BotConsole: {f_playerName}?
